Hi ya'll, I'm using DragonBones for my battlers in RPG Maker MZ-- so I'm using VisuStella's Dragonbones Union with it-- however,  is there no DragonBones motion tag for a battler who is getting revived? because right now when a battler is revived from the <Dragonbones Battler Motion Dead: dead> notetag, it repeats this particular motion then turns to idle. Like, a motion of someone getting up from getting KO'd? I don't see it anywhere in the DB Union plugin descriptions on yanfly.moe.
Any help or ideas is appreciated!
